track.title: Track every application
track.description: No job shall escape! Trackzilla logs every role you go after, complete with timestamps, notes, and juicy details. 🦖 RAWR! Application tracked!

analytics.title: Advanced analytics
analytics.description: Want to know which companies ghost you faster than a vampire in sunlight? We've got cold-blooded stats. Trackzilla sees all. Even your self-doubt. 👁️

followUps.title: Automatic follow-ups
followUps.description: Never let a ghosted app get away. Trackzilla remembers what you forget and roars when it's time to ping. 💌 Grrrrrr... where's my interview?!

dashboard.title: Intuitive dashboard
dashboard.description: See your quest progress with shiny charts and tasty metrics. So easy, even a cave troll could use it. ✨ Oooh, bars go up!

statuses.title: Customizable statuses
statuses.description: Application? Interview? Waiting in eternal silence? Customize your workflow like a true monster master. 🧌 You roll for control.

summon.title: Summon in seconds
summon.description: No tutorials. No rituals. Just click and boom, your job-hunting lair is live. ⚡️ Trackzilla has entered the chat.

extension.subtitle: Transform your LinkedIn browsing into a job-tracking powerhouse. One click to rule them all!
extension.description: Our Chrome extension transforms LinkedIn into your personal job-tracking command center. See a job you like? BAM! It's tracked. Company details? BOOM! Auto-extracted. Status updates? ZAP! Done without leaving the page.
features: Auto-extract job details and company info
Instant status updates without leaving LinkedIn
extension.cardDescription: The ultimate LinkedIn job tracking companion that makes your browser 10x smarter

analytics.title: Monster-Slaying 101
analytics.description: TrackZilla gives you detailed insights into your response rates, helps you spot success patterns, and optimizes your job hunting strategy. It's like having analytics superpowers for your career! 📊
benefits: Automatic response time tracking (because who has time to count days?)
Identify the most responsive companies (find the keepers!)
Smart suggestions to level up your approach (like having a job hunt mentor)
